name: Buffalo Lake Farmers' Market
tagline: Buffalo Lake Farmers' Market in Buffalo Lake, Minnesota
description: Buffalo Lake Farmers' Market is a farmers market in 400 E Yellowstone Trail, MN, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
